AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Erosion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Erosion.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Erosion.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Erosion.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Water: seedbed pits? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.

14. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming cleaning? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming cleaning.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming cleaning.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming cleaning.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming cleaning.

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Controlling Soil Erosion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Water: seedbed pits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Wild Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Small Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
